summary.text: Sam Bell is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 5 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A geologist by training, he has served in the Senate since January 1, 2019, succeeding Paul Jabour.

paragraphs.text: Sam Bell earned a bachelor's degree from Amherst College in 2011 and a Ph.D. in geology from Brown University in 2016.
His professional experience includes work as a geologist.
Bell assumed office in the Rhode Island State Senate on January 1, 2019, and his current term ends on January 5, 2027.
For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists him as a member of the Commerce Committee.
